days_meaning: each delivery day adds this much cash to your side

messages.text: Hello, and thank you for meeting me. I would propose 104 P with delivery on day 0.
I appreciate it, thank you. Could we close at 117 P, delivery on day 0, please?
Fair enough, thank you. I will meet you partway: 122 P with delivery on day 0.
Thank you, we are getting close. 126 P and delivery on day 0 works for me.
Thank you for your offer. I can do 133 P with delivery on day 0.
